versions.content: If (inputBuffer != NULL &&EndToEndTransformationDescrip- tion.upperHeaderBitsToShift> 0), out-of-place E2EXf_Inv_<transformerId> shall copy the first upper HeaderBitsToShiftbits from inputBuffer to buffer, and then copy the re- maining part of inputBuffer skipping E2E header (i.e. starting with offset upperHeader BitsToShift+BufferProperties.headerLength) to parameter buffer starting with the des- tination offset of (upperHeaderBitsToShift).
